# Requirements

Make grounded user and developer documentation the automatic final stage of every Codify spec flow by reusing the configured agent connector, task-tagged snapshots, code graph, memories, and qualification evidence.

## Requirement 1: Documentation is part of completion

**User Story:** As a project owner, I want every feature to close with verified documentation so that completed code and published understanding cannot drift apart.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the final ordinary leaf task qualifies THE spec engine SHALL expose a reserved documentation stage instead of reporting the feature fully complete.
2. WHEN documentation qualifies THE feature SHALL report complete, and WHEN documentation fails THE implementation tasks SHALL remain qualified while the documentation stage remains pending or blocked.
3. WHEN a new feature spec is created THE documentation stage SHALL be enabled by default, with explicit manual and off modes available for project policy.
4. WHEN an existing feature has no documentation configuration THE engine SHALL preserve backward compatibility and provide an explicit enable or migration path.

## Requirement 2: Evidence-grounded documentation packet

**User Story:** As a coding agent, I want a compact authoritative documentation packet so that I can update project docs without inventing behavior.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN documentation becomes eligible THE packet SHALL combine requirements, design, acceptance criteria, task traces, task-tagged snapshots, changed symbols, routes, entry points, memories, verification results, and the existing documentation inventory.
2. WHEN evidence is absent or contradictory THE packet SHALL identify the gap instead of converting an inference into a product claim.
3. WHEN the project has no completed documentation baseline THE planner SHALL request a full user and developer baseline, and subsequent closures SHALL request evidence-driven incremental updates.
4. WHEN a documentation section is generated THE derived provenance ledger SHALL map its claims to repository paths, symbols, tasks, or commits.

## Requirement 3: Reuse the existing agent connector

**User Story:** As a developer, I want documentation to use Codify's configured agent so that the feature adds no second agent runtime or provider integration.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN cg spec run reaches the documentation stage THE orchestrator SHALL launch it through the configured Codex, Claude, or custom driver with the existing lease, fence, heartbeat, logging, and recovery behavior.
2. WHEN an interactive MCP or editor agent completes the final implementation task THE returned state SHALL make the documentation stage the next work item so the same connector can continue it.
3. WHEN documentation becomes eligible inside an agent-owned completion call THE engine SHALL enqueue the stage and SHALL NOT recursively spawn a nested agent from cg spec done.

## Requirement 4: Complete user and developer outputs

**User Story:** As a project user and maintainer, I want the right documentation views updated so that I can use, operate, extend, and verify the delivered feature.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN documentation is planned THE output SHALL distinguish user guidance, developer guidance, release or migration notes, and project-specific exclusions.
2. WHEN canonical documents already exist THE agent SHALL update them within the configured target scope, SHALL preserve unrelated human material, and SHALL never delete or rename documents automatically.
3. WHEN canonical documents are missing THE planner SHALL select conventional README and docs paths without requiring a framework-specific dependency.

## Requirement 5: Verification and provenance

**User Story:** As a reviewer, I want deterministic documentation checks and traceability so that fluent prose cannot impersonate accuracy.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN cg docs check runs THE command SHALL validate configured targets, local links, referenced repository paths, documented commands, symbol and route claims, changed-public-surface coverage, and required audience sections where evidence permits.
2. WHEN a check cannot prove a claim THE command SHALL fail or report it as explicitly unresolved according to policy and SHALL never mark the documentation stage done.
3. WHEN documentation qualifies THE engine SHALL create a task-attributed Codify snapshot and cg docs trace SHALL connect documentation outputs to source tasks, commits, symbols, and evidence.
4. WHEN the feature is used through MCP or VS Code THE documentation plan, status, generation packet, check, and trace SHALL remain truthful and visible.
